units.passage: In recent months, artificial intelligence (AI) became the focus of conversation in many institutes of higher education, including Loyola University Chicago, as faculty, students, staff, and administrators struggled with ways to allow AI into the classroom and beyond in constructive practices. These tools are here to stay and will continue to shape our futures in education, the world of work, science, technology, and research.
